_note: Sample cards from content/copy.md, worded so nobody can mistake them for real reviews. No stars, score, count, job tags or links on a sample. Replace with Shawn's chosen Facebook reviews word for word (initials, name, date, post link); never edit these into real-sounding reviews. home feeds the one card on the homepage. reviews_page feeds the Reviews page grid in reading order: a quote item is one card, a photo item is one stock photo (a name from data/image-manifest.json and its alt), never inside a card, and never next to a card about the same job (copy.md). facebook_url is the bare platform address until Shawn sends his page (content/placeholders.md).
